en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a wide cobblestoned town square lined with multi‑story historic buildings. On the right stands an equestrian statue on a high pedestal in front of an ornate corner building with striped awnings. Shops and inns with German signs front the square; pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing and a handcart are visible, along with a small dog. A slender tower rises in the distance over the roofline, and a decorative lamp or column stands near the center of the image.
